# Vehicle Seat with Enhanced Luggage Storage Capability

## Purpose of the Invention

The present invention aims to provide a vehicle seat in which the vacant space created after tipping up the seat cushion can be effectively utilized as a luggage storage space. By enabling this space to serve a practical secondary function, the invention seeks to improve the versatility and utility of the vehicle interior.

## Structural Overview

To achieve this objective, the vehicle seat is equipped with a support leg that bears the weight associated with the seat cushion. This support leg provides the necessary structural stability to safely carry the loads acting upon the seat. In addition, the seat includes a leg holding member that holds the lower part of the support leg, securing it firmly in place and ensuring reliable operation.

## Slide Mechanism

The vehicle seat incorporates a slide mechanism that enables the seat cushion and seat back to move together in the front and back direction. This mechanism allows the seat to be repositioned along the vehicle floor, offering flexibility in adjusting the available space according to the needs of the occupants or the storage requirements.

## Tip-Up Function

A key feature of the seat is its tip-up function, which rotates the seat cushion so that its front is raised higher than its rear. As a result of this motion, the seating surface and the front surface of the seat back come to face each other. This configuration compactly folds the seat and, in doing so, creates the vacant space that can subsequently be used for luggage storage.

## Positioning of the Leg Holding Member

The leg holding member is positioned on the part of the slide mechanism that moves together with the seat cushion and seat back. By mounting the leg holding member on this moving portion, the support leg and its associated components remain properly aligned with the seat throughout the sliding operation. This arrangement ensures that the seat maintains stable support in all positions while preserving the vacant space required for effective luggage storage.

# Vehicle Seat with Tip-Up and Slide Functions for Enhanced Luggage Storage

## Field of the Invention

The present invention relates to a vehicle seat, and more particularly to a vehicle seat configured to create and effectively utilize storage space within a vehicle cabin. By combining a tip-up function with a slide mechanism, the invention enables the space vacated beneath and around a seat cushion to be used for stowing luggage and other items.

## Background

In many vehicles, particularly those designed to accommodate a variable number of passengers and varying amounts of cargo, it is desirable to reconfigure the seating arrangement to increase available luggage space. One common approach is the "tip-up" mechanism, in which the seat cushion is rotated forward so that its seating surface faces the front surface of the seat back. This action clears the floor area previously occupied by the seat cushion, creating vacant space that can potentially be used for storage.

However, in conventional arrangements, the manner in which the seat is mounted often limits how effectively this newly created space can be exploited. If the components that support and hold the seat in place remain fixed relative to the vehicle floor, the tipped-up seat cannot be repositioned to consolidate and maximize the available storage area.

## Summary of the Invention

To address this limitation, the present invention provides a vehicle seat that effectively utilizes the vacant space created after tipping up the seat cushion, allowing that space to serve as luggage storage.

The vehicle seat comprises the following principal elements:

- **A support leg**, which supports the seat structure relative to the vehicle floor;
- **A leg holding member**, which retains and secures the support leg;
- **A slide mechanism**, which enables the seat to move in the front/back (forward and rearward) direction; and
- **A tip-up function**, which rotates the seat cushion so that its seating surface comes to face the front surface of the seat back.

The key feature of the invention lies in the positioning of the leg holding member. Specifically, the leg holding member is arranged on the portion of the slide mechanism that moves together with the seat cushion and the seat back. Because the leg holding member is mounted on this movable portion, the support leg—and therefore the seat as a whole—can be displaced along the slide mechanism even after the seat has been tipped up.

## Advantages

By locating the leg holding member on the moving portion of the slide mechanism, the tipped-up seat is able to slide forward or rearward as needed. This capability allows the position of the stowed seat to be adjusted so that the vacant space is consolidated and enlarged. As a result, the storage area available for luggage is maximized, and the space created by the tip-up operation can be used more effectively than in conventional configurations.

In summary, the combination of the tip-up function with a slide mechanism whose moving portion carries the leg holding member provides a vehicle seat that not only clears floor space by folding the seat cushion, but also permits repositioning of the folded seat to make the fullest possible use of that space for luggage storage.

# ABSTRACT

A vehicle seat (10) having a tip-up seat cushion mechanism configured to selectively expose a storage space (40) beneath the seat cushion (12) for accommodating luggage. The vehicle seat (10) comprises a seat cushion (12) pivotally coupled to a seat frame (14) at a forward pivot axis (16) by a hinge assembly (18), enabling the seat cushion (12) to rotate between a lowered seating position and a raised stowage position. A seat back (20) extends upwardly from a rear portion of the seat frame (14). A latch mechanism (22) releasably secures the seat cushion (12) in the lowered seating position, and a biasing member (24) urges the seat cushion (12) toward the raised stowage position upon release of the latch mechanism (22). When the seat cushion (12) is pivoted to the raised stowage position, the storage space (40) defined between the seat frame (14) and a vehicle floor (30) is exposed, permitting stowage of luggage or other articles therein. A support surface (32) disposed within the storage space (40) receives the stowed articles, and a retaining feature (34) inhibits displacement of the stowed articles during vehicle operation. The mechanism thereby increases the versatility and cargo-carrying capacity of the vehicle seat (10) without requiring removal of the seat cushion (12).

# Object of the Invention

The present invention relates to an automotive seat, and more particularly to a vehicle seat assembly incorporating support legs, a slide mechanism, and a tip-up function for the seat cushion.

## Objects of the Invention

It is a primary object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat that combines structural support, longitudinal adjustability, and space-saving stowage capability in an integrated and reliable assembly.

It is a further object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat having support legs configured to bear and distribute occupant and seat loads to the vehicle floor, thereby enhancing the structural rigidity and stability of the seat assembly.

It is another object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat equipped with a slide mechanism that enables smooth longitudinal displacement of the seat, allowing an occupant to adjust the fore-and-aft position of the seat according to individual comfort and legroom requirements.

It is a still further object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat having a tip-up function for the seat cushion, whereby the seat cushion is pivotable from a substantially horizontal use position to a raised, generally upright stowed position, thereby increasing the available floor space within the vehicle cabin.

It is yet another object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat in which the support legs, the slide mechanism, and the tip-up function cooperate to permit convenient reconfiguration of the seat between a use condition and a stowed condition without requiring removal of the seat from the vehicle.

It is a further object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat that facilitates ingress and egress of occupants, as well as improved access to a rearward seating row or cargo area, by way of the combined sliding and tip-up movements.

It is another object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat that is durable, structurally robust, and capable of withstanding repeated cycles of sliding and tipping operation while maintaining reliable engagement and secure locking in each of its operative positions.

It is a still further object of the present invention to provide an automotive seat that is relatively simple in construction, economical to manufacture, and readily adaptable to a variety of vehicle configurations.

Other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become apparent from the following detailed description when taken in conjunction with the accompanying drawings.

# Technical Summary: Vehicle Seat with Tip-Up Cushion for Luggage Storage

## Overview

This invention relates to a vehicle seat assembly configured to provide additional cargo storage space through a tip-up seat cushion mechanism. When deployed, the seat cushion pivots upward to a stowed vertical position, creating an open floor area suitable for storing luggage and other cargo.

## Key Components and Structure

### Seat Cushion Assembly
The seat cushion is mounted to allow rotational movement between two positions:
- **Seating position:** The cushion sits horizontally to support an occupant
- **Tip-up (stowed) position:** The cushion pivots upward toward the seat back, exposing the floor area beneath for luggage storage

### Leg Holding Member
A **leg holding member** (support leg) provides structural support to the front portion of the seat cushion during normal use. This member:
- Extends downward from the front of the seat cushion frame
- Supports the load of an occupant when the seat is in the seating position
- Is configured to fold or retract when the cushion is tipped up

### Connection to the Slide Mechanism

The critical structural relationship in this invention is how the **leg holding member connects to the slide mechanism**:

1. **Slide Rail Integration:** The lower end of the leg holding member is coupled to a **slide mechanism** (slide rail assembly) that is mounted to the vehicle floor. The slide mechanism typically comprises a lower rail fixed to the floor and an upper rail that translates fore and aft.

2. **Pivotal Coupling:** The leg holding member is connected to the upper (movable) rail via a **pivot joint or bracket**, allowing the leg to rotate relative to the slide mechanism as the cushion tips up.

3. **Load Transfer Path:** During seating, the leg holding member transfers occupant loads from the cushion frame directly into the slide rail and, ultimately, into the vehicle floor structure. This creates a rigid, stable load path.

4. **Coordinated Motion:** When the cushion is tipped up, the leg holding member is released or unlocked from its supporting engagement, allowing it to swing or collapse toward the slide rail. This clears the storage area beneath the cushion.

## Operational Advantages

- **Space Efficiency:** The tip-up motion maximizes usable cargo volume without requiring seat removal
- **Structural Rigidity:** Anchoring the leg holding member to the slide mechanism ensures proper support and crash performance during normal seating
- **Adjustability:** Because the leg holding member connects to the slide rail rather than directly to the floor, the seat can maintain fore-aft adjustability while retaining the tip-up capability

## Summary Statement

The invention provides a vehicle seat in which the seat cushion tips upward to create luggage storage space, with a leg holding member pivotally connected to a floor-mounted slide mechanism. This configuration achieves both the structural support required for occupant seating and the clearance needed for cargo storage, while preserving seat slide adjustability.

---

*Note: This is a generalized technical summary. For a specific patent or product, exact component nomenclature, claim language, and structural details should be verified against the original source documentation.*

# Seat Assembly with Forward-Rotating Cushion for Space Conservation

## Field of the Invention

The present invention relates generally to seat assemblies, and more particularly to a seat assembly configured to rotate a seat cushion forwardly toward a seat back, thereby exposing floor space beneath the seat assembly when the seat is not in use.

## Detailed Description

Referring now to the drawings, a seat assembly (10) is provided for installation within a vehicle, transit compartment, or similar enclosed space where floor area conservation is desirable.

The seat assembly (10) generally comprises a support frame (12), a seat back (14) fixedly or adjustably mounted to said support frame (12), and a seat cushion (16) pivotally coupled to said support frame (12) by a pivot mechanism (18).

The seat cushion (16) includes an upper seating surface (20) upon which an occupant is supported in a deployed position, and an underside surface (22) disposed opposite said upper seating surface (20).

The pivot mechanism (18) is disposed generally along a forward edge (24) of the seat cushion (16) and defines a substantially horizontal pivot axis (26) extending transversely relative to the seat assembly (10). Said pivot mechanism (18) may comprise one or more hinge members (28), bearings, or a rotary joint permitting angular displacement of the seat cushion (16) relative to the support frame (12).

In operation, the seat cushion (16) is movable between:

- **a deployed position (A)**, wherein the upper seating surface (20) faces generally upwardly to receive an occupant; and

- **a stowed position (B)**, wherein the seat cushion (16) is rotated forwardly about the pivot axis (26) through an arc of approximately ninety degrees or greater, such that the upper seating surface (20) faces toward, and is disposed adjacent to, a front face (30) of the seat back (14).

As the seat cushion (16) transitions from the deployed position (A) to the stowed position (B), the underside surface (22) rotates downwardly and forwardly, and a floor region (32) previously occupied beneath the seat cushion (16) is thereby exposed, increasing available floor space (34) within the surrounding environment.

In one embodiment, a biasing member (36), such as a torsion spring, gas strut, or counterbalance, is operatively coupled to the pivot mechanism (18) to urge the seat cushion (16) toward the stowed position (B), and/or to dampen movement of said seat cushion (16) between positions.

A latch assembly (38) may be provided to releasably retain the seat cushion (16) in at least one of the deployed position (A) and the stowed position (B). The latch assembly (38) may include a manually or automatically actuated release member (40) permitting selective disengagement thereof.

In a further embodiment, a stop member (42) is disposed on at least one of the seat back (14) and the support frame (12) to limit forward rotation of the seat cushion (16) and to define a resting position of the upper seating surface (20) against or proximate to the front face (30) of the seat back (14).

## Advantages

By rotating the seat cushion (16) forwardly against the seat back (14), the seat assembly (10) selectively frees the floor region (32) and increases usable floor space (34), thereby accommodating standing occupants, cargo, mobility devices, or improved circulation, without requiring removal of the seat assembly (10) from its mounted position.

---

*Note: The reference numerals above are illustrative and would correspond to features depicted in accompanying patent drawings (e.g., FIGS. 1–3), which are not reproduced here.*
